reason: The damp cabin air is the source of recoverable moisture, so connecting a hose to the dehumidifier seems like a useful start.
expectation: I expect a way to collect or route condensed water, though it may still need treatment.

effect: The hose collected condensate, so I can now prepare it for reuse.
reaction: The collection followed naturally, though I am curious what treatment it needs.
reason: The processor should make the recovered condensate suitable for the water system.

reaction: That makes sense, though I would have liked more detail about the treatment.
reason: The roots need nutrient solution, and adding concentrate to clean water follows the earlier preparation.
expectation: I expect recovered nutrient solution for the growing troughs.

alternatives.reason: The pump and hose might circulate the water, but I want to prepare the solution first.

effect: The clean water is now recycled nutrient solution; it still needs a route to the roots.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the water become useful plant feed again.
reason: The hose and pump are the only gameplay combination offered and seem useful for moving the solution.
expectation: I expect a circulation line or pump assembly for the troughs.

effect: The pump and hose formed an aerating return loop, suggesting circulation also supplies air to the roots.
reaction: The aeration detail is interesting; I had expected only transport.
reason: The only offered combination connects the prepared solution to the return loop.
expectation: I expect the recycled solution to circulate back through the growing system and complete the goal.

effect: The solution and loop made a recirculating reservoir and completed the moisture recovery goal.
reaction: Closing the loop feels satisfying, although I wanted a little more explanation of how it works.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the aerating return loop gave a useful connection between circulation and the roots' need for air, and completed a tangible reuse system with the reservoir.

leastWorthwhile.text: Processing the condensate was straightforward but gave only a clean-water label; I wanted to know what treatment was needed.

surprise.text: The return loop was described as aerating, which I had not expected from simply joining a hose and pump.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the connection from the pump and hose to aeration was not explained.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical water cycle and earlier ice discoveries make me curious about what the expedition builds or finds next, though I hope for more detail in the results.
